study type: Diagnostic model development and validation study
cohort: Participants included multiple cohorts from the Gene Expression Omnibus database, providing placental tissue samples and maternal plasma data from preeclampsia patients and controls.
finding: A nine-core pathway-level model was developed and validated for preeclampsia diagnosis using gene expression data, demonstrating high diagnostic accuracy (AUROC range 0.815-0.959) and identifying LCK as a hub gene downregulated in placentas from PE patients.
